label: CPS counter
description: Clicks per second over a sliding window.
settings_description: Settings for the CPS counter HUD mod. Derived entirely in JS from mouse edges on the `keys` event (§3), so no Java sensor exists for it.

default_placement.note: Beside FPS in the top row, as the Cartridge fight HUD (Figma 630:2) draws it: FPS 96 wide at 20, CPS 128 wide at 122, Ping at 256, a 6 px gap between 56 px modules.

mode.description: Which mouse buttons to count: left only, right only, or both shown side by side.

show_label.description: Whether to render the trailing "CPS" unit after the figures. Every other readout on the HUD can drop its unit; this one could not, which left it the widest chip on screen for a player who already knows what the number is.

window_ms.description: Length of the sliding window in milliseconds over which clicks are counted before being scaled to clicks per second.

show_peak.description: Whether the highest rate seen this session is drawn as a trailing aside. `window_ms` already averages, so the live figure answers "how fast am I clicking"; this answers "how fast can I", which is the number worth comparing against and the one the live figure never sits still long enough to show.

ignore_cancelled.description: Whether only clicks the game acted on are counted. A left click swallowed by 1.8's miss delay, or made while a screen was open, is a press of the button but not a swing, and with this on it does not count. Left button only; right clicks are always counted as pressed. Fed by `hits.swings` on the tick payload rather than by the mouse edge, so a counted click is one `doAttack` ran for.
